subject.title: fix(agy): suppress tool use and file links in print-mode summaries

question: Should this PR accept the small reduction in maximum Antigravity prompt capacity in exchange for suppressing tool narration and local file links in no-tools summaries?
rationale: The implementation is correct and well proven, but only the repository owner can accept this user-visible compatibility tradeoff for prompts near the platform argv limit.

options.title: Accept the bounded tradeoff
options.body: Merge the focused fix because clean text-only output is worth the small, explicitly checked reduction in maximum prompt capacity.

options.title: Wait for native agy control
options.body: Pause until Antigravity exposes a true no-tools flag, preserving current prompt capacity but leaving the reported contamination unresolved.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded tradeoff
recommendation.body: Merge the focused fix because clean text-only output is worth the small, explicitly checked reduction in maximum prompt capacity.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner, steipete is the best available decision owner for accepting this CLI-provider compatibility tradeoff.
